status_definitions.native_equivalent: The corresponding action is implemented through one or more native iii functions with worker-specific schemas. This does not claim HTTP, authentication, storage, response-shape or live-tested OpenWA parity.
status_definitions.partial: A stated subset of the OpenWA operation is implemented; notes identify missing behavior.
status_definitions.not_implemented: No worker implementation of the operation is provided. Related native primitives or event observations do not imply implementation.

verification: Function mappings were inspected in worker registration source. Offline tests validate request handling and projections. No live WhatsApp account has been paired for end-to-end validation.
